about_the_game:
Gameplay

Another Day Off combines fluid 2D pixel art animations with detailed 3D voxel environments, creating a striking and immersive visual style. Players explore the unsettling town of Liverfield, seamlessly switching between side-scrolling action and 3D exploration. Combat is intense and strategic, as you face a variety of mutated enemies known as The Sick, each requiring different tactics. Collect weapons, upgrade your skills, and survive challenging boss fights in a dark, atmospheric world that tests both reflexes and strategy

Story

In Another Day Off, you follow Damon Gibbs, a young police officer ready to leave behind his uneventful life in the quiet town of Liverfield. Orphaned early and emotionally detached, Damon plans a fresh start with the Police special forces. However, on his final day, an outbreak transforms the town’s residents into violent, cannibalistic monsters. Trapped amid chaos, Damon must explore Liverfield and its outskirts to uncover the truth behind the catastrophe—whether it’s a sinister experiment, a bioweapon, or something more. As danger mounts and mysteries deepen, the boundary between reality and nightmare grows increasingly unclear.

content_descriptors.notes: Another Day Off contains stylized violence and blood, disturbing scenes, and horror themes featuring contaminated bodies. It includes strong language and intense psychological tension. Not suitable for players under 14

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

short_description: This demo lasts about 10–15 minutes and is designed to showcase the game’s atmosphere and a short linear section focused only on shooting and combat. Exploration, puzzles, story progression, and other areas are not included. Limited build, still in development.
